summary: Software Engineer with experience building internal tools, backend services, and data pipelines that improve operational reliability. Proven ability to develop deterministic processing systems and partner with product and operations teams.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built internal workflow tools in Node.js that reduced manual support operations for account onboarding, directly supporting operations team efficiency.
Implemented deterministic data transformation steps for customer document processing, improving output consistency and reliability across runs.
Collaborated with product and design to ship reporting features used by sales and operations teams weekly.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Developed backend endpoints and data validation logic for dashboard exports used by enterprise customers, supporting API reliability.
Improved CI debugging by simplifying log output and surfacing clearer failure categories, enhancing delivery discipline.
Fixed frontend layout issues in the analytics UI to improve user experience.

projects.name: Resume Render Pipeline
bullets: Designed a deterministic pipeline that converts fixed resume JSON into fixed HTML and PDF outputs for reproducible rendering.
Separated data, templates, and scripts to keep rendering behavior stable and easy to debug.
Kept implementation dependency-light to reduce moving parts and improve reproducibility.

projects.name: Interview Tracker
bullets: Built a small application to track job applications, interview stages, and follow-up deadlines for personal job search management.
Defined a clean JSON export format so application records could be inspected and migrated without database coupling.
Focused on simple, maintainable code paths instead of heavy abstractions or framework-specific features.
